cap: In midline section the peritoneum dips twice: shallowly between bladder and uterus (vesicouterine pouch) and deeply between uterus and rectum (rectouterine pouch), which lies on the posterior fornix and is reached by culdocentesis. The retropubic space is extraperitoneal. The diagonal conjugate runs from the sacral promontory to the lower pubic symphysis, and a weak floor lets the bladder or rectum bulge into the vagina.
